Messages.Author: Sascha Neumayr
Messages.Body:
Howdy!

At the German EC qualifier there was a very interesting and (nearly)
game-deciding argument we had...

One player played Derange on my Arika and turned her to Malkavian Antitribu
claiming that with the change of clan she also loses her title and her
votes.

I argued that although she changed the *clan*, she didn't change the *sect*
and therefore she is still the Inner Circle-member of the Camarilla she has
always been and retains her votes.

Judge Frank Moeller decided against me which I had to accept but was his
decision correct? Does Derange nullify the affected vampire's title and his
votes?

Vampirically yours,

Sascha

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3b66715c$0$25866$6e36...@newsreader02.highway.telekom.at>,
Sascha Neumayr <sascha....@gmx.net> writes

>One player played Derange on my Arika and turned her to Malkavian Antitribu
>claiming that with the change of clan she also loses her title and her
>votes.

She changed clan and sect.

>
>I argued that although she changed the *clan*, she didn't change the *sect*
>and therefore she is still the Inner Circle-member of the Camarilla she has
>always been and retains her votes.

Section 10.

If a vampire changes clan to a clan that belongs to a difference sect,
he changes sects as well. (Removing parenthetical text.)

Standard template:

If a vampire changes *clan*, they also change *sect*.
(Derange, Clan Impersonation etc.)

If a vampire changes *sect*, they only change sect.
(Writ)

>Judge Frank Moeller decided against me which I had to accept but was his
>decision correct? Does Derange nullify the affected vampire's title and his
>votes?

Assuming that the vampire had a sect/clan specific title which is not
compatible with Derange (!Malk, Sabbat), yes.

e.g. Regina Giovanni is fine if Deranged, her votes and title are innate
and not tied to her being Independent.

e.g. Gratiano is fine if Deranged, since his votes are tied to his being
Sabbat, not Lasombra.

e.g. Gitane St Clair will suspend her title and votes if Deranged, since
her votes are tied to her being Camarilla.

Messages.Body:
In message <9j9PlEkz...@gratiano.zephyr.org.uk>, James Coupe
<ja...@zephyr.org.uk> writes

>If a vampire changes *sect*, they only change sect.
> (Writ)

Oh, also the new Assamite works here as well.

I'd quite like to see a card that allows similar things for the
Sabbat/Independent, or something. But I guess it's too late to get them
anytime soon. Maybe they'd fit in Bloodlines, who knows.

e.g. a vote Ostracism, P/J/IC, which makes a Camarilla vampire
Independent.

They'd work on a flavour level, for RPG purists, I guess, and they have
a lot of potential for interesting combos/decks.
